39f8fbfec10d.zh: 工业设计的学习经历影响着我理解数字产品的方式。在罗格斯大学，我持续探索产品如何运作、人们如何使用它，以及它需要解决什么问题。

dec7a0dcb919.en: About Yixiao Peng: industrial design background, Rutgers UX Design studies, research, interface design and prototyping.
dec7a0dcb919.zh: 关于 Yixiao Peng：工业设计背景、罗格斯大学用户体验设计学习，以及调研、界面设计与原型实践。

d8f6b66f7153.en: I’m a UX & Product Designer with an industrial design background, currently studying User Experience Design at Rutgers University.
d8f6b66f7153.zh: 我是一名用户体验与产品设计师，拥有工业设计背景，目前在罗格斯大学学习用户体验设计。

7f426bdcc663.en: Industrial design taught me to think about how a product fits into someone’s everyday life. I bring that same curiosity to digital work: what is someone trying to do, what gets in the way, and what would make the next step clearer?
7f426bdcc663.zh: 工业设计让我习惯思考：产品如何融入一个人的日常生活？面对数字产品，我也带着同样的好奇：对方想完成什么，哪里遇到了阻碍，怎样让下一步更清楚？

8fc001a9d49d.en: At Rutgers, I’m building on that foundation through UX research, interaction design, and prototyping.
8fc001a9d49d.zh: 在罗格斯大学，我通过用户体验调研、交互设计和原型实践，继续拓展这份基础。

715f1f69e16a.en: I try to understand the problem before jumping into screens. I organize what I learn, compare ideas, and use prototypes to see how they might work.
715f1f69e16a.zh: 我会先理解问题，再着手画界面。把了解到的信息整理清楚，比较不同想法，并用原型探索它们如何运作。

8449d84b263e.en: I use AI tools to organize research notes, explore ideas, and help build prototypes. I review their output and make the design decisions myself.
8449d84b263e.zh: 我用 AI 工具整理调研笔记、探索想法，也辅助搭建原型。我会核对生成内容，并由自己作出设计判断。

6022497ca4f8.en: Connecting user needs, design decisions, and practical constraints
6022497ca4f8.zh: 将用户需求、设计判断与实际约束联系起来

25001c0a07ac.en: UX/UI design internship · Summer 2026. Research, information architecture, interface design, and AI-assisted prototyping for an internal mobile platform.
25001c0a07ac.zh: 用户体验与界面设计实习 · 2026 年夏。为内部移动平台开展产品调研、信息架构、界面设计与 AI 辅助原型工作。

4efceeff6dc2.en: UX Practicum project · UX research and usability evaluation of an AI-supported clinician dashboard.
4efceeff6dc2.zh: 用户体验实践项目 · 围绕 AI 辅助临床工作台开展用户体验调研与可用性评估。

8b1eee0293cf.en: MBS Externship project · Exploring an AI governance and regulatory system. Work is still developing.
8b1eee0293cf.zh: MBS 校外实践项目 · 探索 AI 治理与监管系统，项目仍在推进中。

a0e8c00b2007.en: I’m interested in the decisions around a design as well as the interface itself: which problem is worth solving, what to prioritize, and what is practical to build.
a0e8c00b2007.zh: 除了界面本身，我也关注设计背后的选择：哪个问题值得解决，什么应该优先，以及怎样才能实际做出来。

8e9aaae5de82.en: As I gain experience, I’d like to explore product management opportunities while continuing to develop my UX and product design skills.
8e9aaae5de82.zh: 随着经验积累，我希望继续打磨用户体验与产品设计能力，也逐步探索产品管理方向。

f7b9e4df5a2c.en: Outside design, I enjoy climbing, gaming, and playing Go. I like working out a route or a strategy, trying it, and adjusting when it doesn’t work. That habit of looking for another approach also shapes how I think about design.
f7b9e4df5a2c.zh: 设计之外，我喜欢攀岩、游戏和围棋。我享受分析路线或策略、尝试，再根据结果调整的过程。这种寻找另一种解法的习惯，也影响着我的设计思考。

7b0fb0f31131.en: Wuhan Marine Machinery: a mobile enterprise platform UX redesign by Yixiao Peng, spanning research, information architecture, UI and prototype development.
7b0fb0f31131.zh: 武汉船机企业移动平台体验优化：Yixiao Peng 的产品调研、信息架构、界面设计与原型实践。

f40d97377069.en: During my summer 2026 UX design internship, I reviewed an enterprise mobile platform used for production, safety and internal services. I handled product research, information architecture, UI design and AI-assisted frontend prototyping within existing business workflows.
f40d97377069.zh: 2026 年夏季实习期间，我参与了面向生产、安全与内部服务的企业移动平台体验优化，负责产品调研、信息架构、界面设计及 AI 辅助前端原型，并遵循既有业务流程。

41337e44e342.en: Product research, UX/UI and AI-assisted frontend prototyping.
41337e44e342.zh: 产品调研、用户体验与界面设计、AI 辅助前端原型。

8faee4275ce5.zh: 设计与模拟数据原型已提交

060f1d7151c2.en: Screenshots, page records and heuristic analysis established the design baseline.
060f1d7151c2.zh: 通过截图、页面记录与启发式分析，建立设计工作的基础。

b279432f1be3.zh: 原应用安全生产管理入口

12521944e044.zh: 观察 → 设计机会 → 设计回应

31ba3514d08c.en: Explore three heuristic findings and their design responses. These observations come from product analysis, not employee testing.
31ba3514d08c.zh: 从三项启发式观察，查看对应的设计回应。它们来自产品分析，并非员工测试。

15f399c37e17.en: Operational and configuration entries share similar weight.
15f399c37e17.zh: 操作入口与配置入口的视觉权重接近。

a577510871b2.en: Broad business entry points have similar visual weight in the original Workbench.
a577510871b2.zh: 原工作台中的不同业务系统入口，视觉权重较为接近。

547d5dfd42f4.en: Separate task context, frequent services and supporting information.
547d5dfd42f4.zh: 区分任务背景、常用服务与辅助信息。

abbf9db90378.en: Keep identity and task status above compact service rows; place warnings in their own area.
abbf9db90378.zh: 在紧凑的服务列表上方保留身份与任务状态，并为警示信息设置独立区域。

e658bcb7dce5.zh: Figma 工作台 / 常用业务

c30a04256618.en: Outline marks the frequent-service area. Editorial emphasis on an unchanged source export.
c30a04256618.zh: 标框指出常用服务区域，仅为原始导出图增加编辑性强调。

68d4ad9a74d4.en: Related work appears in both services and messages.
68d4ad9a74d4.zh: 相关工作同时出现在业务入口与消息中。

27f2d3b78885.en: The audit records overlapping business access without a clear division of purpose.
27f2d3b78885.zh: 审查记录显示，业务访问路径存在重叠，入口之间的用途区分不够清晰。

95255de2fd50.en: Keep both entry paths, with a clear purpose and consistent business labels.
95255de2fd50.zh: 保留两条路径，明确各自用途，并统一业务名称。

0d95c00d20ce.en: Use Workbench for business access and Messages for system-attributed inboxes, followed by task detail.
0d95c00d20ce.zh: 工作台负责业务访问；消息按业务系统组织收件箱，再进入具体任务。

cfa90d13e198.zh: 查看有记录支持的消息路径 ↓

c9b6ea155147.zh: Figma 消息 / 业务收件箱

93e025f078ab.en: Outline marks business attribution. Workbench remains the active service-entry destination.
93e025f078ab.zh: 标框指出业务归属信息。工作台仍承担主动进入业务的功能。

d376eb249c06.en: Form requirements vary across business modules.
d376eb249c06.zh: 不同业务模块的表单要求并不相同。

4937a69cd7fe.en: Original form records have different fields and conditional requirements.
4937a69cd7fe.zh: 原始表单记录包含不同字段与条件要求。

b16175b6ff4c.en: Reuse field patterns while retaining required and conditional information.
b16175b6ff4c.zh: 复用字段模式，同时保留必填与条件信息。

e1f8564ee14a.en: Preserve business-specific fields and show required-input feedback beside the affected field. This frame illustrates the feedback pattern, not field-by-field completeness.
e1f8564ee14a.zh: 保留各业务特有的字段，在相关字段旁显示必填反馈。此图仅说明反馈模式，不证明每一项字段都已完整覆盖。

fb2a44fc57d9.en: Source: August 7 field comparison; August 11 prototype review. Modules without full original forms were not expanded by inference.
fb2a44fc57d9.zh: 来源：8 月 7 日字段对照、8 月 11 日原型检查。缺少完整原始表单的模块未凭推测补全。

89768864b58a.en: Outline marks inline validation. This is a design state, not a user-test result.
89768864b58a.zh: 标框指出行内校验反馈。这是设计状态，不是用户测试结果。

b11b07135463.zh: 工作台 / 原产品与设计方案

a8815117203b.en: From broad entry points to a layered Workbench
a8815117203b.zh: 从同等权重的入口，走向分层工作台

8fe0ca817e42.en: Compare information hierarchy across different capture bounds and design states. The uncropped images do not show equivalent task data or measured results.
8fe0ca817e42.zh: 两张图的截取范围与设计状态不同，用于比较信息层级。原图未裁剪，也不代表相同任务数据或实测结果。

65cace7a8192.en: Broad business systems at similar visual weight.
65cace7a8192.zh: 主要业务系统的视觉权重接近。

9652f85eeb76.en: Identity and task summary, frequent business, then warnings.
9652f85eeb76.zh: 先展示身份与任务概览，再呈现常用业务与警示信息。

ce34d0f3cc12.en: From reference material to a working structure
ce34d0f3cc12.zh: 从参考资料到工作结构

0c7919912841.en: August 10 inventory: 121 reference image files; 37 page entries, including grouped detail routes; 18 form configurations containing 199 field definitions. Each count uses a different unit. These describe project scope, not unique screens, research participants or measured outcomes.
0c7919912841.zh: 8 月 10 日清单：121 份参考图像文件、37 个页面条目（含归组的详情路由）、18 个表单配置及其中的 199 项字段定义。各项使用不同统计单位，仅说明项目范围，不代表独立界面数、研究参与者或实测成效。

835ada4e4dcd.en: Retain the four primary destinations and clarify what each one contains.
835ada4e4dcd.zh: 保留四个主要导航入口，明确各自包含的内容。

bbc3ee766f44.en: Find a service, then enter its business form
bbc3ee766f44.zh: 找到服务，再进入对应业务表单

d0f941eeaed2.en: Example catalog routes, not the complete inventory. Frequent services can also open business forms directly.
d0f941eeaed2.zh: 这些仅为目录路径示例，不是完整清单。常用服务也可以直接打开业务表单。

e49502cbdf9d.en: Design reference for catalog access; later route names come from the page inventory.
e49502cbdf9d.zh: 用于展示目录访问的设计参考；后续路径名称以页面清单为准。

1fef178a6fa4.en: Pending / due / returned / sent are list states.
1fef178a6fa4.zh: 待处理、临期、退回与已发送属于列表状态。

5106d9ccf042.en: The list-to-detail relationship is documented in Figma and the local prototype.
5106d9ccf042.zh: Figma 与本地原型均记录了列表到详情的页面关系。

432e1d5aaa07.en: Keep system and period attached to the metric
432e1d5aaa07.zh: 让指标始终关联业务系统与统计周期

5776870c7f28.en: Choose a business system and period on this screen.
5776870c7f28.zh: 在当前界面选择业务系统与周期。

0144de8b1c27.en: System selection and breakdown are interface states, not additional page levels. No separate L3 page is asserted here.
0144de8b1c27.zh: 系统选择和明细展开属于界面状态，并非额外页面层级。这里不推定存在独立三级页面。

6647c0432395.en: An example design frame. The later period-label inconsistency remains documented.
6647c0432395.zh: 一个设计参考界面。后续周期标签不一致的问题仍保留在记录中。

d90d21664241.en: Keep personal context and settings together
d90d21664241.zh: 将个人信息与设置集中管理

ca849794ff11.en: Editing and toggles are settings states; this overview does not invent a further page level.
ca849794ff11.zh: 编辑与开关属于设置状态；此结构不虚构更深的页面层级。

2b75a9b8bb8d.en: Toggle states are shown inside settings, not as new business pages.
2b75a9b8bb8d.zh: 开关状态位于设置中，不作为新的业务页面。

1732a29dd97b.en: Route examples reconstructed from the 37-entry page inventory and local route handlers. L1–L3 count depth from a primary destination; states are labeled separately. Figma reference screens may precede later frontend refinements.
1732a29dd97b.zh: 路径示例根据 37 项页面清单和本地路由处理逻辑重建。L1–L3 表示从主入口起算的层级，界面状态另行标注。Figma 参考界面可能早于后续前端细化。

134cf98dc2e1.en: Keep familiar business names so service entry and message attribution refer to the same systems. Give frequent services more prominence, while keeping the full catalog and existing form requirements available.
134cf98dc2e1.zh: 保留熟悉的业务名称，让服务入口与消息归属对应同一套系统。突出常用服务，同时保留完整目录与原有表单要求。

c5ec88152294.zh: 主要系统处于相近的视觉层级

89e05dda68e9.zh: 常用业务 → 全部业务

75bc14f64f15.zh: 背景 → 操作 → 辅助信息

be9374772795.en: Prototype structure, reconstructed from the current page database and Figma Main Flow. An earlier five-tab IA exploration separated task discovery from business access; the later four-tab prototype combines them in Workbench. This is an interface reorganization, not a redesign of company approval procedures.
be9374772795.zh: 根据当前页面数据库与 Figma 主流程重建的原型结构。早期五导航探索将任务发现与业务访问分开，后续四导航原型将两者合并在工作台中。这是界面组织的调整，不是对公司审批流程的重构。

bfc3609bf5a2.en: Six visual explorations compare task emphasis, information density and industrial expression.
bfc3609bf5a2.zh: 六个视觉方向，探索任务重点、信息密度与工业气质之间的平衡。

06f98ae646ac.en: Choose a direction to inspect its hierarchy and trade-offs. The notes interpret the preserved designs; they do not report user testing or approval decisions.
06f98ae646ac.zh: 选择一个方向，查看其层级与取舍。说明仅为对保留设计的解读，不代表用户测试或审批结论。

79d802b23412.en: Emphasize identity and the priority task.
79d802b23412.zh: 强调身份信息与优先任务。

06682bf717b4.en: A prominent identity block and priority task create a clear focal point.
06682bf717b4.zh: 醒目的身份区块与重点任务，形成清晰的视觉焦点。

87082ff0595d.en: The large illustrated header uses more vertical space before the service list.
87082ff0595d.zh: 较大的插画式页首占用了服务列表之前的纵向空间。

241780dfdd0e.zh: 探索更轻盈的视觉层级。

f95e15a880aa.en: Compact business rows sit below a distinct identity and task summary.
f95e15a880aa.zh: 紧凑的业务列表位于独立的身份与任务概览下方。

16d4269bb4f8.en: The dark summary remains the strongest visual element despite the lighter surrounding surface.
16d4269bb4f8.zh: 尽管周围界面更轻，深色概览区域仍然占据最强的视觉权重。

0a5eb72980b9.en: A large task card sits beside a narrow operational summary.
0a5eb72980b9.zh: 大任务卡与窄幅运营概览并排呈现。

ea3ec33b26a7.en: Unequal card sizes create several reading paths and require clear priorities.
ea3ec33b26a7.zh: 不同尺寸的卡片带来多条阅读路径，需要明确优先级。

22b480aa021c.en: Task and operational summaries are visible together, with compact business entry rows.
22b480aa021c.zh: 任务与运营信息并列呈现，下方保留紧凑的业务入口。

24276f186b9e.en: More metrics compete for attention; the page needs a clear priority among them.
24276f186b9e.zh: 更多指标同时争夺注意力，需要明确它们之间的优先级。

23b8bd1d13eb.en: Provide an overview of current work.
23b8bd1d13eb.zh: 提供当前工作的整体视图。

cbfcac78a0bd.en: A shift overview and task trend are separated from the business-system list.
cbfcac78a0bd.zh: 将班次概览与任务趋势，同业务系统列表分开。

e2e9e54b9eb4.en: The overview and featured task place business entry further down the page.
e2e9e54b9eb4.zh: 概览与重点任务使业务入口进一步下移。

faa8bb967467.en: Large system cards and a distinct status strip make business categories visible.
faa8bb967467.zh: 较大的系统卡与独立状态条，让业务分类更突出。

5ea0094c984d.en: The large cards use more vertical space than compact service rows.
5ea0094c984d.zh: 相比紧凑的服务列表，大卡片需要更多纵向空间。

41fb5268deed.en: Compare the visual trade-offs; no formal ranking or selection rationale is documented.
41fb5268deed.zh: 比较视觉取舍；目前没有正式排名或方案选择依据的记录。

6d5321ed4e44.zh: 当前可编辑 Figma 方向

eb2dc69934c4.zh: 区分状态信息与导航入口。

55fc35f86830.zh: 让提醒拥有自己的信息层。

3aeef860d5a5.en: The r6 demo starts on Crane Operations. Open Reporting Trend, then By Crew to reach the breakdown and its export entry.
3aeef860d5a5.zh: r6 演示默认选择起重作业报工系统。打开「报工趋势」，再选「按班组」即可查看分布及导出入口。

0cb4c1ef1b8b.en: In the r6 machining form, saving with an empty required field shows an inline error. Canceling after an edit opens a confirmation. Notification controls are under Management.
0cb4c1ef1b8b.zh: 在 r6 加工记录中，必填项为空时保存会显示字段提示，编辑后取消则会打开确认框。消息通知设置从管理页进入。

8f5c3da5629c.en: The r6 demo includes separate entries for safety registration, hazard rectification and machining records. The field audit is the reference for their structure.
8f5c3da5629c.zh: r6 演示分别提供安全事项登记、隐患整改和加工记录入口。各表单的组织方式参考了原有字段核查。

7fa705103431.en: Compare the information hierarchy in the original Workbench and the r6 handoff. The screenshots use different framing and data.
7fa705103431.zh: 对照原始工作台与 r6 交付版的信息层级。两张截图的取景与数据不同。

059c5c132214.en: In the r6 demo, open the Crane Operations inbox and select the pending lifting report for details and available actions.
059c5c132214.zh: 在 r6 演示中打开起重作业报工系统的收件箱，再选择待处理的吊装报工，查看详情和可用操作。

48fa537ad9e0.en: These screenshots come from the r6 frontend and use the package’s mock data.
48fa537ad9e0.zh: 这些截图来自 r6 前端，使用交付包内的模拟数据。

3ac166085015.en: Show the period on the trend and its crew breakdown so readers can keep track of what they are comparing.
3ac166085015.zh: 趋势页和班组分布页都显示统计周期，方便读者理解当前比较的范围。
